scope: Offline Git index snapshot; all stage-0 tracked paths. No hardware/network/services/cache discovery; no removal.
size_semantics: size_bytes is Git index blob length, not dirty worktree length, LFS payload size, allocated disk space or deduplicated object total. Symlink size is stored link text length. Category totals overlap tracked_venv and its subcategories.

lfs_detection.method: Standard LFS v1 header and oid/size syntax in index blobs <=1024 bytes; no .gitattributes tracked. Private paths excluded from content inspection. No LFS fetch or smudge.

model_weights.finding: No tracked neural checkpoint identified. All weight-extension matches are tracked venv distutils-precedence.pth Python path hook; code model IDs and result filenames are not weights. External Hugging Face caches and ignored/untracked paths were not inspected; locally installed weight presence is unknown.

venv.keep: Preserve current files during this documentation phase. Existing analyze/report workflows require cv2/numpy/scipy; the tracked venv is not the external depth environment.
venv.extract: Record Python/platform constraints, dependency versions/licenses and reproducible environment recipe; metadata/RECORD manifests are available in the tracked venv.
venv.delete_condition: Only in a separately authorized cleanup after a replacement environment reproduces analyze.py and m3-m4-session/report.py offline, command/document references are updated, and provenance requirements are retained. No deletion authorized now.

runtime_calibration.keep: Required runtime input or dynamically imported helper, despite living under calibration/. Front camera YAML is an export artifact; retain until package/export consumers are mapped.
runtime_calibration.extract: If reorganized, install/package calibration data and helper, rewrite repo-relative consumers and verify offline behavior.
runtime_calibration.delete_condition: Never delete by blanket calibration-directory policy; replace every runtime/export consumer and validate first.

ros_install.keep: setup.py installs URDF, config, RViz and STL resources; Xacro consumes mount calibration and mesh package URIs.
ros_install.extract: Move only through a separate approved package migration preserving installed resource resolution, generator and tests.
ros_install.delete_condition: Only if no URDF/setup/visualization/test consumer remains and replacement is validated.

depth_experiment.keep: Prototype CLI explicitly selects Small, Base or Depth Pro; model result JSON is evidence, not checkpoint data.
depth_experiment.extract: Preserve CLI, calibration/detection dependencies and validation provenance in an experiment/archive boundary before retiring Base/Depth Pro comparisons.
depth_experiment.delete_condition: Only after confirming no source/test/docs or intended experiment needs it, retaining approved result provenance, and separately authorizing removal. Do not remove ROS Small worker or shared external depth environment.

evidence.keep: Calibration history can be referenced by regression tests and installed-config provenance; default is keep, not disposable output.
evidence.extract: Audit per-file consumers, preserve provenance/privacy and archive with stable paths or update every reference.
evidence.delete_condition: No blanket deletion. Require per-file consumer search, provenance retention and authorized validation before retirement.

ros_depth.keep: Optional ROS depth layer invokes persistent external Python worker, which defaults to DA2 Metric Indoor Small and cached-only model loading.
ros_depth.extract: If made optional in packaging, retain launch/node/worker/geometry and document external environment/cache requirements.
ros_depth.delete_condition: Only with explicit deprecation of optional ROS depth feature and verified launch, package entry point and downstream consumer changes.

unknown.keep: Unclassified binary/model candidate: do not infer weights from names.
unknown.extract: Identify producer, format, license, reproducibility and every consumer before deciding.
unknown.delete_condition: No disposal until positively identified and separately authorized.

other.keep: Not a disposal target of this asset audit.
